readings.title: 改了的周末计划
readings.levelSuggestionZh: 教学建议：日常叙事，大约 A2，未经认证分级。先读英文，中文按段展开。
readings.narratorNote: 第一人称虚构叙事；人物不是助手或用户本人。原创学习故事，不是真实经历。

paragraphs.en: On Thursday evening, I made a plan with two friends, Mei and Chris. We wanted to take the Saturday morning train to a small town and walk around the old streets.
paragraphs.zh: 星期四晚上，我和两个朋友阿梅、克里斯约好了。我们想坐星期六早班火车去一个小镇，在老街上走走。

paragraphs.en: I thought about the trip all day Friday. After work, I packed a small bag and set my alarm for six.
paragraphs.zh: 星期五我一整天都在想着这次出行。下班以后，我收拾好一个小包，把闹钟定到六点。

paragraphs.en: At nine, Mei messaged me. Her sister's plane was arriving late, and Mei wanted to meet her at the station. She couldn't go on Saturday anymore.
paragraphs.zh: 九点时，阿梅给我发了消息。她姐姐的飞机要晚到，她想去车站接她。星期六她去不了了。

paragraphs.en: I told Chris. He said we could still go, just the two of us. I didn't want to leave Mei out of a trip we had planned together.
paragraphs.zh: 我把这事告诉了克里斯。他说我们两个还可以去。可我不想把阿梅撇在我们一起计划的旅行外面。

paragraphs.en: So we decided to stay in the city and have lunch instead. I told Mei she could join us if her sister needed to rest first.
paragraphs.zh: 于是我们决定留在城里，改成一起吃午饭。我告诉阿梅，要是她姐姐先去休息，她也可以过来。

paragraphs.en: Saturday morning, I was almost ready to leave when Chris called. His neighbor had asked him to help carry a table up the stairs, and it was taking longer than he thought. He asked if we could eat an hour later.
paragraphs.zh: 星期六早上，我快要出门时，克里斯打电话来了。邻居请他帮忙把一张桌子抬上楼，时间比他想的要长。他问能不能晚一个小时再吃。

paragraphs.en: I said there was no rush. I sat by the window with a book. After all the changes, the quiet morning felt a little strange, but not bad.
paragraphs.zh: 我说不着急。我坐在窗边看书。经过这一连串改动，安静的早上有点奇怪，但并不坏。

paragraphs.en: We met at one. Mei came after all — her sister wanted to rest at the hotel first. The noodle place was busy, so we waited outside for a few minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们一点钟见了面。阿梅到底还是来了——她姐姐想先在旅馆休息一会儿。面馆人多，我们在外面等了几分钟。

paragraphs.en: After lunch, we walked along the river and went into a small bookstore. Chris found a map of the town we hadn't visited, and we laughed. Mei bought a postcard for her sister.
paragraphs.zh: 午饭后，我们沿着河边走，进了一家小书店。克里斯找到一张我们没去成的那个镇的地图，大家都笑了。阿梅给姐姐买了一张明信片。

paragraphs.en: On the way home, we chose a new day for the train: the weekend after next, if everyone is free. This time, I won't pack until we are really going.
paragraphs.zh: 回家路上，我们重新选了坐火车的日子：如果大家都有空，就定在下下个周末。这一次，我要等真的要出发了再收拾行李。

notes.meaningZh: 把某人排除在外、没把某人算进去。本篇 I didn't want to leave Mei out 是不想把一起约好的朋友撇在一边。不是离开某个地方的 leave。
改成吃午饭。instead（改为、取而代之）是已有词卡，本篇只复现。

notes.expression: I was almost ready to leave
notes.meaningZh: 我快要出门了。这里的 leave 是离开（已有词卡），和 leave Mei out 不是同一个意思。
不着急。No rush 是已有语块，本篇只复现。
阿梅到底还是来了。after all 这里表示情况最后还是发生了，尽管前面好像来不了。本篇先整句记，不另建必背卡。
下下个周末。比 this weekend（这个周末）和 next weekend（下个周末）再远一周。

optionalTakeaways.en: I didn't want to leave Mei out.
optionalTakeaways.zh: 我不想把阿梅撇在外面。

readings.title: 找对楼层
readings.levelSuggestionZh: 教学建议：日常工作叙事，大约 A2+，未经认证分级。先读英文，中文按段展开。
readings.narratorNote: 第一人称虚构叙事；人物不是助手或用户本人。原创学习故事，不是真实工作记录。

paragraphs.en: Tuesday started like most of my workdays. I got to the office a little after nine, made tea, and opened my email. I had a short list of things to finish before lunch.
paragraphs.zh: 星期二开始得和多数上班日差不多。我九点刚过到办公室，泡了茶，打开邮箱。午饭前我还有一份不长的待办清单。

paragraphs.en: At ten, my manager, Paula, stopped by my desk. Two people from another office were coming at three to talk about a shared project. She asked me to print a few copies of the notes and get the small meeting room ready.
paragraphs.zh: 十点时，经理葆拉走到我桌边。另一处办公室有两个人三点要来谈一个共同的项目。她让我把笔记打印几份，并把小会议室准备好。

paragraphs.en: I said I would take care of it. I wanted everything ready before they arrived. Last month, a visitor had waited in the wrong hallway, and I still remembered how awkward that felt.
paragraphs.zh: 我说这事交给我。我希望他们到之前一切都准备好。上个月，有一位来访者在错误的走廊里等过，我还记得那种尴尬。

paragraphs.en: I put the meeting on the shared calendar and sent the visitors a short message with the time and the floor. Then I went down the hall to print the notes.
paragraphs.zh: 我把会议记到共用日历上，给来访者发了条短消息，写上时间和楼层。然后我走到走廊尽头去打印笔记。

paragraphs.en: The printer started, then stopped. The light said it was out of paper, but the tray was already full. I took the paper out and put it back. Nothing changed.
paragraphs.zh: 打印机响了一下，又停了。指示灯显示没纸了，可纸盒里明明是满的。我把纸取出再放回去，情况没有变化。

paragraphs.en: I tried again from another computer. The same light came on. I didn't want to bother anyone yet, so I waited a few minutes and tried once more. It still didn't work.
paragraphs.zh: 我换另一台电脑再试。还是同一盏灯亮了。我暂时不想麻烦别人，就等了几分钟再试一次，还是不行。

paragraphs.en: At a quarter to twelve, I asked Ken, who sits next to me. He came over, opened the side of the printer, and pulled out a small folded piece of paper I hadn't seen. "It does that sometimes," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 差一刻十二点，我问了坐在旁边的肯。他走过来，打开打印机侧面，抽出一小张我没看见的折叠纸片。“它有时候会这样。”他说。

paragraphs.en: After that, the copies came out fine. I checked the first page and saw last week's date at the top — I had printed the old notes. I still had time, but not a lot.
paragraphs.zh: 之后，打印出来的份数就正常了。我核对第一页，看见最上头是上周的日期——我打印成旧笔记了。我还有时间，但并不多。

paragraphs.en: I found the right file, printed it again, and checked every page. Then I looked back at the message I had sent. I had written "third floor," but the small room is on the second floor. That was the same kind of mistake as last month, only this time I caught it early.
paragraphs.zh: 我找到正确的文件，重新打印，并逐页检查。然后我回头看自己发出的消息。我写的是“三楼”，可那间小会议室在二楼。这和上个月是同一类错，只是这次我发现得早。

paragraphs.en: I sent a second message with the right floor and went downstairs to put a small note on the door of the wrong room, just in case someone still went there. At five to three, I was in the right room, with the copies on the table.
paragraphs.zh: 我又发了一条消息，写上正确的楼层，然后下楼，在错误房间的门上贴了一张小纸条，以免还有人走错。差五分三点，我已经在正确的房间里，打印稿放在桌上。

paragraphs.en: The visitors found the room without any trouble. After they left, I wrote a short reminder for myself: check the floor, check the date, and look inside the printer before I start to worry. It was an ordinary day, when a few small things could have gone wrong, and I was glad they didn't.
paragraphs.zh: 来访者没费什么事就找到了房间。他们离开后，我给自己写了一小段提醒：先核对楼层和日期，也先看看打印机里面，再开始着急。这不是戏剧性的一天。只是普通的一天里，几件小事本可能出错，而我很高兴它们没有。

notes.expression: I would take care of it.
notes.meaningZh: 这事交给我、我会处理好。take care of it 常用来接下一件需要完成的事，不是“照顾某人”。
错误的那条走廊。hallway 是已有词卡。后面 the wrong room 是同一类说法。
纸用完了。这里复用已有语块 We're out of / be out of（没有了、用完了），不是 outside。

notes.expression: It still didn't work. / It does that sometimes.
notes.meaningZh: 还是不能正常运转。work 在这里是“能用”（已有卡 sc2-work），不是上班。It does that sometimes（它有时候会这样）也是已有语块。

notes.expression: last week's date / I caught it early
notes.meaningZh: 上周的日期。这里的 last 是“上一个”（L08-V02），不是末班车的 last。caught it 是发现了问题（sc2-catch），不是赶上车。

notes.expression: third floor / second floor / the right floor
notes.meaningZh: 三楼、二楼、正确的楼层。floor 在这里指大楼的层数，不是地板。right 是“正确的”。
以防万一。本篇是怕还有人走到错误的房间，所以先在门上留条。
一小段提醒、备忘。这里是写给自己看的，不是手机通知的技术讲法。

wordCards.senseZh: 把某人排除在外、没把某人算进去
wordCards.collocation: leave someone out / I didn't want to leave her out
wordCards.exampleEn: I didn't want to leave Mei out of a trip we had planned together.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我不想把阿梅撇在我们一起计划的旅行外面。
wordCards.transferEn: If we eat now, we'll leave Sam out. He isn't here yet.
wordCards.transferZh: 我们现在吃的话，就把萨姆撇在外面了。他还没到。
wordCards.notesZh: 和离开某处的 leave（l14-w-leave）不是同一个意思。本卡只学“没把某人算进去”。另境例句改到一起吃饭，不用本篇周末出行。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。

wordCards.collocation: the weekend after next / the week after next
wordCards.exampleEn: We chose a new day for the train: the weekend after next, if everyone is free.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我们重新选了坐火车的日子：如果大家都有空，就定在下下个周末。
wordCards.transferEn: I can't come this Saturday, but I'm free the weekend after next.
wordCards.transferZh: 这个周六我来不了，但下下个周末有空。
wordCards.notesZh: this weekend 是这个周末，next weekend 是下个周末，the weekend after next 再远一周。weekend、free 只复现。另境例句改到不能来的约定，不用本篇改出行计划的全过程。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。

wordCards.senseZh: 把这件事处理好、交给我来办
wordCards.collocation: I'll take care of it / I would take care of it
wordCards.exampleEn: I said I would take care of it.
wordCards.transferEn: You can go to lunch. I'll take care of the phone.
wordCards.transferZh: 你去吃午饭吧。电话交给我。
wordCards.notesZh: 常用来接下一件需要完成的事。不是“照顾某个人”，也不是“小心一点”。另境例句改到看管电话，不用本篇准备会议室。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。

wordCards.collocation: the second floor / the third floor / the right floor
wordCards.exampleEn: I had written "third floor," but the small room is on the second floor.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我写的是“三楼”，可那间小会议室在二楼。
wordCards.transferEn: The bookstore is on the first floor, next to the entrance.
wordCards.notesZh: 本卡只学大楼的层数。不是房间里的地板。the right floor 是正确的那一层。另境例句改到书店，不用本篇接待来访者。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。

wordCards.collocation: just in case / just in case someone still went there
wordCards.exampleEn: I put a small note on the door of the wrong room, just in case someone still went there.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我在错误房间的门上贴了一张小纸条，以免还有人走错。
wordCards.transferEn: Take an umbrella, just in case it rains.
wordCards.transferZh: 带把伞吧，以防万一下雨。
wordCards.notesZh: 用来提前做一点准备，避免可能发生的麻烦。另境例句改到带伞，不用本篇会议室。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。

wordCards.senseZh: 提醒、备忘（写给自己或别人看的）
wordCards.collocation: a short reminder / write a reminder
wordCards.exampleEn: I wrote a short reminder for myself: check the floor, check the date.
wordCards.exampleZh: 我给自己写了一小段提醒：先核对楼层和日期。
wordCards.transferEn: I left a reminder on the fridge: buy milk tomorrow.
wordCards.transferZh: 我在冰箱上留了条提醒：明天买牛奶。
wordCards.notesZh: 这里是提醒事项，不是手机软件的技术讲法。另境例句改到冰箱便条，不用本篇工作日。
wordCards.provenance: 原创学习例句，非转载语料。
